content.text: Change = 1,278,402 − 1,266,289 = 12,113. Percent = 12,113 / 1,266,289 × 100 ≈ 0.9566%, which rounds to 0.96%. To one decimal place that is 1.0%.

input.answer: Saskatchewan's population grew by about 1.0% between July 1, 2025 and July 1, 2026. It went from 1,266,289 to 1,278,402, a gain of 12,113 people. The percent change is 12,113 / 1,266,289 × 100 = 0.957%, which rounds to 1.0% at one decimal. I used StatCan's quarterly population estimates (table 17-10-0009).
